title: Starbucks Was Sold for $3.8 Million (Six Stores)
description:
Starbucks once had just six stores, and it was sold for $3.8 million to Howard Schultz, a former employee who had left to start his own coffee bar. He raised the money from investors, with help from Bill Gates Sr., by August 1987.

He bought the name, the roasting plant and all six Seattle stores, and began serving coffee drinks in them. That one deal became the global chain.

⚠️ Dramatised: characters and scenes are illustrations. The facts are real.
